verdict.rationale: Datadog has a first-party AI product, Bits AI (title only). It also ships its own plugin that lets users analyze experiments in ChatGPT, which is a narrow natural-language surface. The pack does not describe Bits AI accepting natural-language commands or what it can operate. The MCP server is a separate agent-integration story and is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented natural-language querying and actions across monitors, logs, dashboards and incidents; a description of Bits AI's command capabilities; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Analyze your experiments in ChatGPT with the Datadog Experiments plugin
